title: PKCS7 padding oracle: DecryptionFailed leaks padding error vs wrong-CEK
description: decrypt_aes128_cbc and decrypt_aes256_cbc return SmimeError::DecryptionFailed(format\!("AES-128-CBC: {e}")) where {e} is the unpad error string. The aes-cbc / block-padding crate's UnpadError variants differ between 'invalid padding' and 'invalid length' — these strings are exposed verbatim in the error. A remote caller that can observe which error variant or which substring appears can mount a padding-oracle attack on the CBC ciphertext. The error string should be flattened to a single constant message regardless of sub-cause.
close_reason: UnpadError displays as 'unpad error' with no subtypes. Both wrong-CEK and bad-padding return the same SmimeError::DecryptionFailed variant. No information leak beyond the variant discriminant. Opinion.
